mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over the past three months indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes a recession and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 6.5% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (indicating monetary tightening) and the unemployment rate is above 6.0%, it signals a dual stress of tight policy and weak labor market, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts below 750.0 (thousands of units) and a decline in retail sales below 350000.0 (millions of dollars) signal weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 750.0 and RSAFS < 350000.0 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) over the past month signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has fallen below 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 350000.0 (millions of dollars) over the past month indicates weakening consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS has fallen below 350000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising above 3.0% and the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy stance in the face of rising inflation, which typically causes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates a delayed rate hike.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls growth below 100000.0 (thousands of persons) over the past month signals a slowing labor market, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has declined below 100000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
